lines: Today is a momentous day in the history of Verehn; on this very day, five years ago, our illustrious leader, Lady Svetka, overthrew the corrupt monarchy and took hold of our dear country.
With strength and resilience that knows no bounds, our fearless leader has ensured the safety of all citizens from the dastardly Spoiled.
In other news, Spoilage has reached a record low within the past month.
Our scientists are currently working on breakthrough discoveries, as we grow closer to finding a cure for this pandemic.
That is all for now. Stay safe, and eat well.
